title: Backup restore drill (row-count proxy)
notes: Wraps scripts/backup-verify.mjs's runBackupVerify() (exported this session, no CLI behavior change) over BENCH_PROD_READONLY_URL: non-zero row counts on the evidence-of-record tables (docs/DATA_RETENTION_POLICY.md, src/lib/student-archive.ts) as info, and storage_reachable as the one exact:true metric (1 = the configured object-storage backend answered ListObjectsV2, 0 = misconfigured or unreachable). THIS DOES NOT VERIFY A BACKUP OR A RESTORE — same limitation backup-verify.mjs documents in its own header: it has no access to Supabase's backup subsystem. A real restore drill is a quarterly OWNER STEP (docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md §5); this suite is the automatable proxy that runs in between, not a replacement for it.
